scope: frozen records on main that cite a CI run's head commit by an id of 7 to 40 hex digits naming no object, which is not a prefix of the run's real head and shares at least its first 7 hex digits with it

status_rule.rule: a verdict not confirmed does not hold; a confirmed verdict holds when its explanation is confirmed, and partly holds when its explanation is incomplete or not confirmed

fields.assertion_verbatim: the citing line exactly as it stands in the citing blob, without its newline
fields.summary: a shortened paraphrase of the citing line, for reading; not the original
fields.shared_digits: the number of leading hex digits the cited id shares with the real head
fields.pin: how the citing blob is pinned: a receipt's control_plane_blobs entry, or the record directory at the receipt commit (the commit that last wrote the receipt)
fields.content_checks: statements about the real head that E3 re-derives from the stored objects
fields.derived_facts: facts computed from an object that is not retained here, with the method; E3 checks only what checked_here says
fields.host_facts: host answers not tied to one job, with their date and, for a listing, its digest

found_by.tool: collision_scan.py [--full-only] COMMIT LISTING; the hex_40_only counts are --full-only
found_by.rule: same line: on each line naming a listed run id, each hex token of 7 to 40 digits is compared with the heads of the runs the line names; a token that is no head's prefix, shares its first 7 hex digits with one, and names no object is a collision. Corpus-wide: every hex token on every scanned line, run id or not, that names no object and shares its first 7 hex digits with a listed head of which it is not a prefix
found_by.listing: GitHub Actions runs API, all 2,200 runs of amaybaum/incompleteness, read 2026-10-16; a host record, not committed
found_by.objects: the clone the scan ran in, which holds the real heads and the off-main objects of the preservation bundles
found_by.note: the 40-hex-only rule finds PE-1 to PE-4; the 7-to-40 rule finds those four and PE-5, whose cited id has 8 digits; the same five at both commits, and the corpus-wide pass finds no other; every 11-digit decimal token outside a decimal fraction is a listed run id, so no cited run lies outside the listing

evidence_kinds.listing: the run's head_sha in the GitHub runs API listing
evidence_kinds.job_records: each job's head_sha, run_attempt, conclusion and times from the GitHub jobs API (list_workflow_jobs), read 2026-10-17
evidence_kinds.host_refusal: GitHub get_commit on the cited id answered 'No commit found for SHA' (PE-1 to PE-4 on 2026-10-16, PE-5 on 2026-10-17)
evidence_kinds.served_log: job-log text served by GitHub (get_job_logs, at most the last 5000 lines), 2026-10-17; the digest names the served text, which is not byte-identical to the original log and is not committed
evidence_kinds.git: facts read from the git objects stored in objects/ (for a commit on main, from the repository); check_errata.py re-derives them in any clone of main, and through git commands as well where the real heads are present
evidence_kinds.derived: a fact computed from a named object that is not retained here, with the method and the object id

object_store.form: complete: each file is a git object exactly as git hashes it, the header "<type> <size>\0" followed by the uncompressed body, so its sha1 is its name and it is byte-identical to the host's object of that id; check_errata.py verifies every file by id (E5a)

cross_reference_census.finding: on main, each cited id occurs once, at its own citing line; no prefix of a cited id or of a real head occurs anywhere, and no real head is named; each run id occurs only at its citing line, except run 36612901341, whose id also occurs, without a head, at two lines of act 45 (PE-4); no mutable summary, roadmap, manuscript, manifest or archive entry names any of the five; .tex files are scanned
